name: Nagykovácsi (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Nagykovácsi (a crowned red and blue shield with a Hungarian shield and an anvil, with red and blue mantling) above a yellow scroll inscribed NAGYKOVÁCSI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagykovácsi arms with crown, mantling and scroll
